<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/commit_project_git/{guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Commits staged changes in the current user's dev clone of the project
using the supplied commit message, and emits a script-commit system
event. Returns 400 if there is nothing staged or the message is blank,
404 if the project doesn't exist, and 502 if the underlying git commit
fails for another reason.
